title: ZuCo 1.0: Simultaneous EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading
description: ZuCo 1.0 is a dataset of simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recordings collected while adult native English speakers read natural sentences. It includes three reading tasks: sentiment reading, normal reading, and task-specific reading with semantic annotation. The dataset is intended to support research combining neurophysiological and oculomotor measures of natural language reading.
methods_description: Data were recorded using a 128-channel EGI Geodesic EEG system (500 Hz sampling, Cz reference) and an EyeLink 1000 eye-tracker (500 Hz, left eye) simultaneously while participants read sentences under three different task conditions (sentiment reading, normal reading, task-specific reading).
